findings.highlight: The sound of the second hand on the clock
findings.evidenceJa: 寸分も狂わずに響く秒針の音
findings.governingReading: the second hand sounding with not the slightest deviation
findings.explanation: The oppressive mechanical precision that makes the ticking grate on Shirou is omitted.

findings.highlight: how long are you going to sleep?
findings.evidenceJa: いつまで寝ぼけてるのよ
findings.governingReading: how long are you going to remain half-asleep?
findings.explanation: Rin is addressing Shirou’s lingering sleep-daze after waking, not asking how long he will continue sleeping.

findings.highlight: Illya’s bugging me to get dinner ready
findings.evidenceJa: ご飯を食べさせろってイリヤがうるさい
findings.governingReading: Illya is clamoring that someone feed her
findings.explanation: Illya’s blunt demand to be fed becomes a request directed specifically at Rin to prepare dinner.

findings.highlight: An angry voice.
findings.evidenceJa: 不機嫌そうな声
findings.governingReading: a displeased-sounding voice
findings.explanation: Rin’s irritable mood is intensified into outright anger.

findings.highlight: I get up quickly.
findings.evidenceJa: ガバッ、と体を起こす
findings.governingReading: He bolts upright.
findings.explanation: The sudden sit-up from bed is blurred into the broader act of getting up.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka looks flabbergasted.
findings.evidenceJa: 目の前にはあきれ顔をした遠坂がいた
findings.governingReading: Rin stands before him with an exasperated look.
findings.explanation: Weary disbelief at Shirou’s behavior becomes astonishment, and her physical presence is reduced to an expression.

findings.highlight: ignoring Tohsaka’s words behind me
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の怒鳴り声を受け流しながら
findings.governingReading: letting Rin’s shouted voice wash past his back
findings.explanation: The force of Rin shouting after him and Shirou’s embodied dismissal are flattened.

findings.highlight: Saber could be anywhere.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーは何処にもいない
findings.governingReading: Saber is nowhere to be found.
findings.explanation: An observed absence becomes unrestricted possibility about her location.

findings.highlight: Right where I fled from her.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺が走り去った時と同じ
findings.governingReading: She looks exactly as she did when he ran away.
findings.explanation: Continuity of Saber’s frozen posture over five hours is changed into a statement about location.

findings.highlight: a red horizon that has already disappeared
findings.evidenceJa: 有りもしない赤い地平
findings.governingReading: a red horizon that does not exist
findings.explanation: Saber seems to see an imagined horizon absent from the night; the English instead treats it as a once-visible horizon that has vanished.

findings.highlight: so weak that my hand might go through her if I reach out
findings.evidenceJa: 手を伸ばせばすり抜けてしまいそうなほど儚い
findings.governingReading: so ephemeral that she seems liable to slip through his hand if he reaches for her
findings.explanation: An image of transience and inability to hold on to Saber becomes physical weakness and a hand passing through her.

findings.highlight: she defends her pride until the end
findings.evidenceJa: おそらくは最後まで、その誇りを守り続ける
findings.governingReading: She will probably protect that pride to the very end.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s おそらく inference is asserted as certain future conduct.

findings.highlight: I would never let her make such a face.
findings.evidenceJa: あんな顔はさせない
findings.governingReading: He will never cause or allow her to wear that expression again.
findings.explanation: The English makes Saber the agent producing the face and Shirou the controller who permits it, hardening his protective resolve into control over her expression.

findings.highlight: I should apologize to her.
findings.evidenceJa: それは、悪いことをした
findings.governingReading: Then I have done Rin a wrong.
findings.explanation: Saber’s acknowledgment of wrongdoing becomes an invented future act of apology.

findings.highlight: I could not think what I should do or where I want to go
findings.evidenceJa: 何をするべきか、何をしたいのか、何処に行きたいのか思い浮かばず
findings.governingReading: She can think of neither what she ought to do, what she wants to do, nor where she wants to go.
findings.explanation: The central inability to identify any desire of her own is omitted from Saber’s explanation.

findings.highlight: She must feel guilty, as Saber keeps averting her gaze.
findings.evidenceJa: 負い目があるのか、セイバーは俺から視線を逸らしてばかりだ
findings.governingReading: Perhaps from a sense of guilt, Saber keeps averting her eyes.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s tentative reading of Saber’s behavior is promoted to certainty.

findings.highlight: Is she saying she’ll wander around without a place to return to?
findings.evidenceJa: 一人で、帰る場所もなく彷徨っているとでも言うのか、ばか
findings.governingReading: Is the fool saying she will wander alone with nowhere to return to?
findings.explanation: Shirou’s intimate, exasperated ばか disappears from the thought that prompts him to reclaim her home.

findings.highlight: you said you do not understand me
findings.evidenceJa: シロウはもう私の事など知らない、と
findings.governingReading: you said you wanted nothing more to do with me
findings.explanation: Saber invokes Shirou’s earlier relational rejection; the English prematurely substitutes the different sense of 知らない used in his reply and erases their deliberate semantic mismatch.

findings.highlight: will catch a cold if they stay out here this long
findings.evidenceJa: こんなに冷えたら風邪を引く
findings.governingReading: Even a Servant will catch cold after becoming chilled this badly.
findings.explanation: The bodily degree of Saber’s cold is replaced by the duration of being outside.

findings.highlight: looking away from Saber
findings.evidenceJa: 出来るだけセイバーから目を逸らして言った
findings.governingReading: He says it while averting his eyes from Saber as much as possible.
findings.explanation: The extent of Shirou’s embarrassed effort to avoid her gaze disappears.

findings.highlight: while holding my hand
findings.evidenceJa: 俺に手を握られたまま
findings.governingReading: with her hand still held by him
findings.explanation: The source preserves Shirou as the active holder while Saber quietly follows; the English assigns the holding to Saber or makes it mutual.

findings.highlight: We keep walking.
findings.evidenceJa: ずかずかと歩く
findings.governingReading: Shirou strides forward brusquely.
findings.explanation: His deliberately rough, embarrassment-covering gait and singular agency disappear.

findings.highlight: She must be freezing and be tired as well.
findings.evidenceJa: 疲れもたまっているのかもしれない
findings.governingReading: She may also have accumulated fatigue.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s tentative physical explanation is made certain immediately before Saber denies being physically unwell.

findings.highlight: it is not because of Rin
findings.evidenceJa: 凛の言葉に踊らされるワケではありませんが
findings.governingReading: not that she is being led around by Rin’s words
findings.explanation: Saber’s explicit recollection of Rin’s teasing definition and her resistance to being influenced by it are reduced to a vague denial of causation.

findings.highlight: start to pray with that priest
findings.evidenceJa: あの神父に祈ってもいい
findings.governingReading: he might change creeds and pray to that priest
findings.explanation: The joke casts the priest himself as the object of prayer; the English makes him Shirou’s fellow worshipper.

findings.highlight: someone we never should have met
findings.evidenceJa: 決して出会ってはならないモノ
findings.governingReading: a thing or entity they must never encounter
findings.explanation: The dehumanizing, ominous モノ is normalized into an ordinary person before the encounter explains itself.
